title: Common compute request
description: The shared request shape for compute operations: tax_year plus either inline facts (one-shot) or a return_id referencing an assembled workspace. tax_year is a FIELD, never part of the path or tool name.

tax_year.description: 2024 | 2025 | 2026. ty2026 ships as data that REFUSES what the IRS has not announced.

return_id.description: Reference to an assembled workspace, in place of inline facts.
